quizzes.question: Why should you use filters before saving a Smart List?

options.option_text: Filters are required but not useful
Filters help you find the specific group of contacts you want. Once the filters are correct, you can save that view as a Smart List
You don't need to use filters first

quizzes.explanation: Filters are the foundation of a Smart List. They define which contacts appear in the list. Getting the filters right ensures your Smart List shows exactly who you want.

quizzes.question: Where do you go to add a filter?
quizzes.explanation: To add a filter, navigate to the Contacts page and click on 'Add Filter' to start building your criteria.

quizzes.question: What should you do after setting up filters?

options.option_text: Review the contacts returned to make sure they match what you want
Send emails to all filtered contacts

quizzes.explanation: Always review the contacts that your filters return to ensure you're getting exactly the group you intended before saving as a Smart List.
